final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(CASE WHEN t.Milliseconds > 0 AND t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS REAL) ELSE NULL END) as avg_bytes_per_ms, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.avg_bytes_per_ms, step1.track_count, (step1.avg_bytes_per_ms - step2.overall_avg) as diff FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.avg_bytes_per_ms > step2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) as col1, AVG(CAST(track_count AS REAL)) as col2, AVG(diff) as col3 FROM step3
